# The QEMU suites as qemu.yml runs them: one shard a line, its name and
# then its suites, each shard on a runner of its own. Every suite that
# `build test --suite list` names, the fuzz targets apart, is in exactly
# one shard; the images job fails otherwise. The longest suites
# (installed-base, the power-pull ones) are spread out.
base: ipl status dhcp static-vlan time inventory supervision power-pull slot-confirm shutdown sockets
install: install-serial install-display install-unattended mirror-degraded mirror-replace install-power-pull
mirror: mirror-power-pull storage-kill tools-network tools-sign-on media-refused answers-invalid mirror-start mirror-split
vmm: installed-base partition-boot partition-scsi partition-ipl-a partition-ipl-b partition-attributes partition-kill
qs400: partition-power-pull partition-end partition-damaged partition-privilege partition-recorded
partd: partition-define partition-three partition-minimum partition-dedicated partition-capped partition-uncapped partition-core-sched partition-huge-pages partition-auto-start partition-killed partition-manager-restart partition-identity partition-isolation partition-own-disks partition-tools
pools: pool-create pool-thin-thick pool-full pool-pulled-mirrored pool-pulled-raid5 pool-pulled-raid6 pool-lost pool-power-pull pool-kill
media: pool-install pool-vdisk-rules pool-optical pool-tape pool-media-damaged pool-upload pool-foreign pool-tools
network: net-switch-create net-internal net-tagged net-uplink net-uplink-loss net-management net-may-not net-host-unreachable net-not-required net-live
network-qs400: net-qs400 net-throughput net-counters net-service-kill net-vmm-kill
service: service-codes service-states service-none service-silent service-auto-wait service-delayed service-system service-terminal service-panel service-hostile
service-console: service-console service-install-console service-dumps service-dump-restart service-manager-restart service-host-power-off service-tools
qsi: qsi-listen qsi-pairing qsi-trust qsi-families qsi-streams qsi-log qsi-two-consoles qsi-hostile qsi-service-kill
qsi-flows: qsi-end-to-end qsi-events qsi-power qsi-qsictl
servicing: svc-problems svc-problem-kill svc-problem-pool svc-processor svc-hostdump svc-tools svc-qsictl svc-away svc-capture
update: svc-update svc-update-back svc-update-mirror svc-update-power svc-update-refused svc-update-rollback
physio: pio-nvme pio-refused pio-group pio-iommu-off pio-held pio-reset pio-restart pio-isolation pio-hostile pio-tape-double pio-entitlement
physio-installed: pio-tools pio-qsi
physio-tape: pio-tape-save pio-tape-volumes pio-tape-span
